# StackLight

Signal tower with 1 to 5 tiers (IND-020 .. IND-022, IEC 60073 colors).

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.StackLight(
    value=["blink", "off", "on", "off"],
    label="StackLight",
    tiers=["red", "amber", "green", "blue"],
    labels=["Fault", "Warning", "Running", "Call"],
    buzzer=True,
    size=(140, 200),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[120,200]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `tiers` | array of enum | `["red","amber","green"]` | host | Tier colors from top to bottom. |
| `labels` | array of string | `[]` | host | Meaning of each tier, shown as text (A11Y-003). |
| `value` | array of enum | `[]` | host | State of each tier. Resolved to one state per tier: missing states are off, extra ones ignored, an unknown state reads as off (the Python class pads or cuts the list when the tiers change). |
| `buzzer` | boolean | `false` | host | Show a sounding buzzer indicator (no sound is played). |
